fusions.name: Cloud of Blades
fusions.desc: Looses 5 knives in a wide spread, each dealing 5 damage. Your afflictions on a target it hits spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gnawing Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a knife that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stripping Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm of tiny blades for 8 seconds. Every second it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage.

fusions.name: Field Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
